tagline: Design and make a better world
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) is the primary growth and valuation driver at Autodesk, which has fully transitioned to a SaaS model, with over 90% of its revenue being recurring and predictable.

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue generated from software subscriptions.
kpis.description: Autodesk derives over 93% of its revenue from subscriptions, ensuring high predictability and stable margins.
kpis.signal: Mature SaaS model with strong visibility

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct costs.
kpis.description: High gross margin reflects the software nature of the business model, with minimal direct variable costs.
kpis.signal: Very high margin typical of SaaS software vendors

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin contracts slightly in FY2026 due to restructuring charges of $216M, impacting expected progression.
kpis.signal: Slight compression due to restructuring costs

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: Autodesk continues to invest heavily in innovation, particularly in AI, cloud, and platform, with $1,643M in R&D expenses in FY2026.
kpis.signal: High R&D maintained for AI and platform innovation

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (cloud infrastructure)
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Investments are primarily directed toward cloud infrastructure and technology platform, representing approximately 5-6% of revenue.
kpis.signal: Moderate and stable Capex focused on cloud infrastructure

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount decreases slightly in FY2026, indicating rationalization and the impact of $216M in restructuring charges.

kpis.name: Share of cloud deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud deals that include AI and Autodesk AI capabilities.
kpis.description: Autodesk is increasingly integrating its Autodesk AI engine into cloud offerings, particularly in Fusion, Forma, and other applications, with Autodesk AI reflecting a decade of investment.
kpis.signal: Accelerating adoption of AI in design and manufacturing workflows

kpis.name: Monthly Active Users Fusion
kpis.explanation: Number of monthly active users of the Fusion cloud platform for manufacturing.
kpis.description: Fusion, central to the cloud manufacturing strategy, is seeing accelerating adoption driven by convergent generative design, simulation, and cloud capabilities.
kpis.signal: Strong growth of flagship cloud manufacturing platform

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $7.206 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2026).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.124 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2026).

risks.title: Limited adoption of new products and services
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in 10-K (Item 1A), mentioned in the introduction of risk factors with strong language on 'large expenditures' without guaranteed ROI. Critical for AI/cloud strategy.

risks.title: Increased competition and technological disruption
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in summary of risk factors. Threat of market share losses and margin compression noted. Context: emergence of competing AI tools.

risks.title: Dependence on international revenues
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in risk factors. ~64% of revenue from international operations exposes the company to structural regulatory, currency, political, and geopolitical risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data incident risks
risks.score_rationale: Enumerated in risk factors. For a SaaS/cloud company, data or IP compromise would be existential to reputation and operations. Risk increases with cloud expansion.

risks.title: Predictability of subscription renewal rates
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in risk factors summary. Autodesk's SaaS model (93% of revenue) critically depends on renewal rates, which are difficult to predict with precision.

risks.title: Risks related to strategic acquisitions and integration
risks.score_rationale: Listed as a major risk factor. MDA details acquisitions (Payapps FY2025, simulation FY2024) with explicit mention of integration costs and potential disruptions.

risks.title: Increased regulation on data protection and compliance
risks.score_rationale: Global trend of tightening regulation (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) leading to rising compliance costs. Structural risk for multi-jurisdictional SaaS companies.

ai_positioning.summary: Autodesk positions AI as a core capability of its platform (Autodesk AI), integrated across all products (Fusion, Forma, etc.) with nearly a decade of investment. AI is key to automating, augmenting, and analyzing customer workflows.
evidence: Autodesk AI cited as a ~10-year investment integrated into the platform
AI integration in Fusion (generative design), Forma, and cloud workflows
Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers embedded to standardize AI-enabled integrations
AI used for augmentation, automation, and analysis of customer workflows
35% of cloud deals now include AI features
